methods.candidate_workaround: Switch to the Node-backed filesystem and direct child-process surface, then use no-profile PowerShell only for narrow Windows-native inspection.
methods.failure_signature: The first memory, skill, and trivial date probes through the default PowerShell tool host repeatedly exceeded their bounds without producing output.
methods.recurrence_guard: Test the shell host with one trivial bounded probe and change command surface after a no-output timeout instead of repeating compound reads.
methods.rollback: Stop, retain the failed witness at zero credit, and leave external and sibling state unchanged.

methods.candidate_workaround: Split revision, tracked cleanliness, complete cleanliness, tracking equality, and live-remote checks into isolated scalar probes with explicit outer bounds.
methods.failure_signature: A combined source head, branch, upstream, status, divergence, and shallow-state probe exceeded the Node tool's thirty-second outer bound.
methods.recurrence_guard: Never combine large-worktree status traversal with unrelated revision and remote checks under the default outer timeout.
methods.rollback: Stop, retain the failed witness at zero credit, and leave external and sibling state unchanged.

methods.candidate_workaround: Narrow verification to the exact source worktree, committed receipts, known validation roots, and declared receipt digests.
methods.failure_signature: A breadth-first search across the D-drive archive for an external exact-final receipt exceeded its two-minute bound.
methods.recurrence_guard: Do not recursively search the full archive when exact branches, paths, hashes, and manifest contracts already delimit the evidence.
methods.rollback: Stop, retain the failed witness at zero credit, and leave external and sibling state unchanged.
methods.title: Bounded recovery for archive-wide-external-receipt-search-timeout

methods.candidate_workaround: Build each manifest comparison map from the complete declared commit tree while retaining the manifest entry allowlist.
methods.failure_signature: The first 732-entry manifest audit scoped Git tree maps to the phase directory and falsely reported missing script and test blobs.
methods.recurrence_guard: Manifest entries may span phase docs, scripts, and tests; scope by the manifest paths, not by one directory prefix.
methods.rollback: Stop, retain the failed witness at zero credit, and leave external and sibling state unchanged.
methods.title: Bounded recovery for phase-root-limited-manifest-tree-map

methods.candidate_workaround: Inspect the original Git PID and worktree index, wait for that one checkout to end, then run one full clean-state probe.
methods.failure_signature: An early status probe ran while the original large checkout was still populating the worktree and exceeded its four-megabyte output cap.
methods.recurrence_guard: Do not interpret a partially populated worktree status as final state or retry worktree creation while the original process remains active.
methods.rollback: Stop, retain the failed witness at zero credit, and leave external and sibling state unchanged.
methods.title: Bounded recovery for incomplete-worktree-status-output-overflow

methods.candidate_workaround: Use tasklist plus no-profile Get-CimInstance for bounded Windows process inspection.
methods.failure_signature: The legacy WMIC process-inspection command was unavailable and returned ENOENT.
methods.recurrence_guard: Detect the available Windows process-inspection surface before relying on legacy WMIC.
methods.rollback: Stop, retain the failed witness at zero credit, and leave external and sibling state unchanged.
methods.title: Bounded recovery for wmic-process-inspection-unavailable

methods.candidate_workaround: Run each executable separately and read package metadata through a literal path.
methods.failure_signature: A combined Git, Python, Node, Codex, and desktop-package version probe failed process-spawn validation before returning evidence.
methods.recurrence_guard: Keep Windows command wrappers and executable probes isolated so one invalid launch cannot erase all version evidence.
methods.rollback: Stop, retain the failed witness at zero credit, and leave external and sibling state unchanged.
methods.title: Bounded recovery for combined-version-probe-spawn-invalid

methods.candidate_workaround: Use the installed npm package metadata for CLI version and the verified WindowsApps package path for desktop version without executing the packaged binary.
methods.failure_signature: Direct execution of the desktop-bundled Codex binary was denied by the application package boundary.
methods.recurrence_guard: Treat desktop package inspection as status-only and never bypass application-package execution controls.
methods.rollback: Stop, retain the failed witness at zero credit, and leave external and sibling state unchanged.
methods.title: Bounded recovery for bundled-codex-executable-direct-spawn-denied

methods.candidate_workaround: Retain the failed build, revise only the seven colliding titles with domain-specific vocabulary, and rerun the isolated x1 builder.
methods.failure_signature: The first x1 build stopped because seven new proposal titles met or exceeded the 0.60 token-set Jaccard collision threshold against inherited wetland-era titles.
methods.recurrence_guard: Run inherited-title collision screening before freezing x1 and treat domain substitution inside an inherited sentence frame as a collision rather than novelty.
methods.rollback: Stop, retain the failed witness at zero credit, and leave external and sibling state unchanged.
methods.title: Bounded recovery for semantic-title-jaccard-collision

methods.candidate_workaround: Repeat the narrow inspection with JSON ASCII escaping or an explicitly UTF-8 output surface.
methods.failure_signature: The first proposal-title inspection attempted to print Māori text through the default Windows cp1252 console and raised UnicodeEncodeError.
methods.recurrence_guard: Use UTF-8 output or JSON ASCII escaping whenever Windows command output may contain Māori or other non-cp1252 text.
methods.rollback: Stop, retain the failed witness at zero credit, and leave external and sibling state unchanged.
methods.title: Bounded recovery for windows-console-unicode-inspection-failure

recommendations.recommendation: Test the shell host with one trivial bounded probe and change command surface after a no-output timeout instead of repeating compound reads.
Never combine large-worktree status traversal with unrelated revision and remote checks under the default outer timeout.
Do not recursively search the full archive when exact branches, paths, hashes, and manifest contracts already delimit the evidence.
Manifest entries may span phase docs, scripts, and tests; scope by the manifest paths, not by one directory prefix.
Do not interpret a partially populated worktree status as final state or retry worktree creation while the original process remains active.
Detect the available Windows process-inspection surface before relying on legacy WMIC.
Keep Windows command wrappers and executable probes isolated so one invalid launch cannot erase all version evidence.
Treat desktop package inspection as status-only and never bypass application-package execution controls.
Run inherited-title collision screening before freezing x1 and treat domain substitution inside an inherited sentence frame as a collision rather than novelty.
Use UTF-8 output or JSON ASCII escaping whenever Windows command output may contain Māori or other non-cp1252 text.
